T880 · Paper 1 · Code 11040412 · 17 sittings analysed
Which standard or topic appeared in which question — based on actual past papers
⚠️ Syllabus-structure shift observed in 2025 papers: April & August 2025 moved SANS 10198-2 (cables) to Q1, SANS 10292 T/F to Q2, and OHS Act to Q3–Q4. November 2025 appears to repeat this structure (may be same paper filed under a different sitting code — verify before exam). The 2026 papers reverted OHS Act back to Q1 and SANS 10292 to later questions.
OHS Act / EIR / EMR — Legislation & Regulations Q1 · 13/17 | Q3–Q4 · 3/17 | Q10 · 1/17 Q1 (13 sittings): 2004.08, 2005.04, 2005.08, 2006.04, 2007.08, 2016.04, 2016.08, 2016.11, 2017.08, 2017.11, 2024.04, 2026.04, 2026.08 — EIR defs & contractor duties, Electrical Machinery Regs, OHS Act Sections 8–10, confined spaces, employer duties for disconnected machinery. Q3: 2025.04 (OHS + EIR — responsibility for installations; AIA limitations). Q4: 2025.08, 2025.11 (OHS + Construction Regs — contractor safety on construction sites). Q10: 2017.04 (Electrical Machinery Regs user duties re control gear + electric fence impulse limits). SANS 10142-1 — Scope (what is/is not covered) Q2 · 9/17 | Q4 · 2/17 Q2 (9 sittings): 2004.08, 2005.04, 2005.08, 2006.04, 2016.08, 2016.11, 2017.08, 2026.08 — name 6 aspects covered; name 4 not covered (fixtures, aircraft, ships, mines). 2026.08 tested all aspects of SANS 10142-1:2024 edition specifically. Q4: 2025.04 (name 6 special installations covered; 4 not covered), 2026.04 (name 5 premises applicable; 4 non-moving exclusions). Not at Q2 in: 2007.08, 2016.04, 2017.04, 2017.11, 2024.04, 2025.04–2025.11. SANS 10142-1 — Definitions (column-match, fill-in or describe) Q2–Q5 · rotates · 17/17 Q2: 2007.08, 2017.04 (T/F 10 statements), 2017.11  |  Q3: 2006.04 (10 defs by description), 2016.08, 2017.08, 2024.04 (5 × 2 mark defs), 2026.04 (Flexible cable, SELV, ECC, Hazardous location), 2026.08 (Appliance, Cable gland, Circuit breaker + 2)  |  Q4: 2004.08, 2005.08 (appliance classes: Class I, Class II, Fixed, Portable, Stationary)  |  Q5: 2016.11, 2025.04 (5 appliance types with descriptions)  |  Q10: 2016.04 (T/F: ELV, touch voltage, protective device, point of supply, Class I) — Definitions appear in every sitting; slot varies. Note: 2025.08 & 2025.11 tested SANS 10198-1 definitions at Q3 (Cable, Circuit breaker, Earthed, ELPD, Voltage-drop) — a separate standard from SANS 10142-1. SANS 10142-1 — Fundamental Requirements (conductor sizing, SELV/PELV, fire risk, earth fault) Q3–Q6 · rotates Q3: 2017.04 (Annex D load calc: 10 kVA transformer, motors, heaters, lamps)  |  Q4: 2006.04 (est. load, voltage drop, diversity factors), 2016.04 (positioning & accessibility; de-rating), 2017.08 (fire risk area; earth fault), 2017.11 (positioning, voltages)  |  Q5: 2006.04 (wiring types; 6 considerations; SELV connections), 2016.08 (wiring types, emergency control, SELV), 2026.04 (5 safety factors for conductor sizing; SELV/PELV protective separation methods; 2 parts SELV shall not connect to)  |  Q6: 2016.11 (est. load, volt drop, conductor area), 2017.08 (protective device conditions), 2025.08, 2025.11 (paraffin storage design; earth fault protection; voltage at point of supply)  |  Q4: 2026.08 (fire risk area requirements; 5 methods against earth fault currents; 2 ELV protective methods) SANS 10142-1 — Normative References (compulsory standards) Q3 · older papers only Q3: 2005.08 (name 2 compulsory standards; titles of SABS 0198-2, 0292, 1507) — appeared in early papers; bundled into definitions/scope in later sittings. Not seen in post-2016 papers. SANS 10142-1 — Special Locations (pools, medical, construction, agricultural, saunas, temporary, DC, caravan, hazardous) Q1–Q9 · rotates · 17/17 Q1: 2017.04 (Saunas zones 1–4; Construction DB colour/metalwork/sub-DBs)  |  Q3: 2007.08 (Positioning & Accessibility)  |  Q4: 2007.08 (Agricultural), 2016.08 (Saunas)  |  Q5: 2004.08 (combined S.7), 2005.08 (Pools A–G, Construction DB, Medical, ELV, Telecomms), 2007.08 (ELV/SELV/PELV), 2016.04 (Construction DB: live indicator, socket-outlets), 2017.08, 2017.11 (Swimming pools), 2026.08 (Swimming pools, spas, fountains — supplementary bonding; submersible pump)  |  Q5–Q6: 2024.04 (Saunas + Caravan Parks at Q5; Caravan Parks fill-in sentences at Q6)  |  Q6: 2006.04 (Bathrooms zones; Medical verification), 2007.08 (Construction sites), 2017.11 (Temporary), 2025.04 (Bathrooms/Showers/Spas — SELV, shock protection, supplementary bonding), 2026.08 (Hazardous locations — 9 examples)  |  Q7: 2007.08 (Medical), 2016.04 (Medical: IMD specs, socket counts Gp1/Gp2), 2016.08 (Alternative supply), 2017.04 (Medical: applied part, Gp0/1/2, IMD alarms), 2017.08 (Construction sites), 2024.04 (DC Installations), 2025.04 (Construction & Demolition — DB contents), 2025.08, 2025.11 (Swimming Pools — non-submersible & portable pumps)  |  Q9: 2016.04 (Agricultural & Horticultural: sockets, cables, PVC wireways, bonding, soil heating), 2016.08 (Temporary), 2024.04 (CoC authority for farm / bonding)  |  Q10: 2016.11 (Caravan sites) SANS 10142-1 — SELV & PELV Systems (ELV circuit requirements) Q5–Q6 · rotates Q6: 2016.04 (3 protective separation arrangements; SELV vs PELV; plug/socket requirements; 3 instances SELV must not connect), 2017.04 (Reg 5.7.4.4; 3 circuits SELV not connected; 3 protection methods; T/F 12V AC/30V DC threshold)  |  Q5: 2006.04 (SELV connections: 3 instances not connected), 2016.08 (wiring types context — SELV mentioned) — also embedded in Fundamental Requirements questions in 2025–2026 sittings. Know SELV/PELV distinction cold. SANS 10142-1 — Alternative Supply (Inverters, Generators, UPS, PV) Q7–Q8 · selected sittings Q7: 2006.04 (5 steps to limit circulating harmonic currents; 5 precautions to prevent parallel operation), 2016.08 (Alternative sources), 2025.04 (4 methods to reduce circulating current; prevent parallel operation — inverter with battery backup), 2026.04 (inverter+battery diagram — circuits on inverter vs normal supply; failback when inverter fails), 2026.08 (additional requirements for static inverters with UPS/PV on/off-grid; 5 methods to limit circulating harmonic currents)  |  Q4: 2017.04 (Annex Q IEC switchgear symbols; Annex S emergency changeover switch diagram — labels A–E)  |  Q8: 2025.08, 2025.11 (see Alternative Supply — 4 methods to reduce circulating current) SANS 10142-1 — HV Apparatus (fireman's switch, capacitors) Q8 · 2026.04 Q8: 2026.04 (8 points when installing a fireman's switch; installation requirements for capacitors) — first confirmed appearance in P1; likely increasing as HV equipment becomes more common. Know: colour of fireman's switch (red), external position, accessibility, labelling, isolation sequence. SANS 10142-1 — Annexures (C Estimated Load · F Conduit · G IP Ratings · J Earthing · M CoC Authority · Notices & Labels) Q4–Q10 · rotates · strong post-2024 Annex C — Estimated Load: Q8: 2024.04 (double-storey farmhouse, 15 kVA transformer, pool pump)  |  Q9: 2025.08, 2025.11 (150 m² flat, 60 A single-phase)  |  Q10: 2026.04 (300 m² house, 63 A single-phase, stove + geyser + 20 sockets + 20 lights + pool + heating)  |  Q8: 2016.08 (Annex D load calc)  |  Q7: 2017.11 (Annex D load + Annex J IP)
Annex F — Conduit & Cable sizing: Q7: 2016.11 (cable bending, conduit sizing)  |  Q8: 2007.08 (F, J, M), 2016.04 (Annex F bending table, IP, earthing codes), 2025.08, 2025.11 (5 circuits × 2 marks)  |  Q9: 2025.04 (socket + light circuits with Addendum table)
Annex G — IP Ratings: Q5: 2025.08, 2025.11 (5 IP codes × 2 marks)
Annex J — Earthing diagrams: Q6: 2004.08 (IP ratings + CoC authority)  |  Q7: 2017.11  |  Q8: 2007.08, 2016.04, 2026.08 (single-phase system NOT allowed for domestic — draw and label it)  |  Q10: 2025.04 (TN-S earth loop impedance test diagram), 2025.08, 2025.11 (TN-C system diagram)
Annex M — CoC Authority: Q8: 2017.08 (earthing codes), 2017.11 (TN/TT/IT types)  |  Q9: 2026.04 (who may issue CoC — single-phase / 3-phase & DC / specialised)
Notices & Labels (Table 4.2/4.3): Q4: 2024.04 (Table 4.2 — 4 sub-questions)  |  Q7: 2017.04 (Section 4: durable, legible, indelible; 6 topics from Table 4.3)
IP ratings (Annex J/G): Q6: 2004.08, 2005.08 (Annex J 2-digit meaning; CoC in hazardous area) SANS 10198-1/2 — Power Cables ≤33 kV (selection, handling, installation) Q1–Q2 · Q6–Q9 · rotates Q1 — 2025 exam shift (SANS 10198-2 fill-in): 2025.04, 2025.08, 2025.11 — scope; functions; voltage drop; squirrel-cage motors; moisture; armouring; outer protection; vertical shafts (9 fill-in sentences × 2)  |  Q2 — SANS 10198-2 T/F: 2025.11 (10 T/F statements on SANS 10198-2). Also Q2: 2016.04 (scope; 3 general practices; 4 Telkom details)  |  Q6: 2016.08 (restrained vs unrestrained; buried installation)  |  Q7: 2004.08 (scope, installation), 2005.08 (single-core armouring; backfill compaction)  |  Q8: 2017.04 (telecoms induction effects; 4 items to Postmaster-General; air installation)  |  Q9: 2006.04 (scope; 3 practices; 4 Telkom details), 2007.08 (scope, defs, telecoms), 2016.11 (5 sustained-current factors; outdoor pipes), 2017.08 (scope, defs, telecoms), 2017.11 (5 factors; indoor cleats), 2026.08 (Q9 — information to Telkom for proposed power cable; requirements for cables in air) SANS 10292 — Earthing of LV Distribution Systems (scope, TN/TT/IT systems, reasons) Q1–Q2 · Q3 · Q8–Q10 · rotates Q1 (2025.11 only): SANS 10292 fill-in — scope; systems; aerial bundle conductor; consumer earth terminal; fault current; LV/MV definitions (possible duplicate of 2025.08 — verify)  |  Q2 — T/F format (new from 2025): 2025.04, 2025.08, 2026.04 (10 × 1-mark T/F statements on TN-C, TN-S, TN-C-S, TT, IT systems)  |  Q3: 2016.04 (scope; 4 reasons for earthing neutral; TN, TT, IT types)  |  Q8: 2004.08, 2005.08 (4 reasons for earthing neutral), 2016.11 (scope, 4 reasons, TT system)  |  Q9: 2017.04 (scope; DC/AC voltage; definitions: concentric cable, prospective touch voltage, source earthing; 2 reasons for neutral earthing)  |  Q10: 2006.04 (first/second letter of system ID code), 2017.08 (TN-C-S diagram fill-in), 2017.11 (scope; 4 reasons; 2 systems for new distributors), 2024.04 (TN-C-S/TN-S/TT connection configurations), 2026.08 (Q10 — TN-C-S system characteristics; 3 earth electrode materials)  |  Know: T=earth in French (Terre); N=neutral; C=combined; S=separate; TN-C not preferred in SA (PEN conductor carries load current) SANS 1507 — Electric Cables with Extruded Solid Dielectric Insulation Q9–Q11 · older papers only Q9: 2004.08 (combined with SABS 0198 — scope & installation), 2005.08 (why earth conductor tinned in Norsk cable; Which topic appeared in which question — based on actual past papers
Calculations — cable sizing, voltage drop, correction factors Q1 · 2/2 sittings Q1 in both analysed sittings: 2007.08 (cable sizing & volt drop from circuit diagram), 2017.08 (7 correction factors, 5% volt drop limit) Conductors & Cables — installation, positioning, fixing, wireways Q2–Q4 Q2: 2007.08 (neutral current correction), 2017.08 (copper <16mm² annealed)  |  Q3: 2007.08 (motor protection), 2017.08 (5 instances where cable shall NOT run)  |  Q4: 2007.08 (bonding supplementary conductors), 2017.08 (wireways/conduit, flexible conduit, conduit sizing) Earthing — consumer terminal, bonding, ECC, earth conductive parts Q4–Q6 Q5: 2007.08 (conductive parts not needing earthing), 2017.08 (consumer earth terminal connections)  |  Q6: 2007.08 (ECC calculations, Tables 8.1 & 6.28), 2017.08 (bonding: water pipes, antennas, pumps, services) Socket outlets, verification & certification, inspection & testing Q7–Q8 Q7: 2007.08 (10 visual inspections + 10 tests for CoC), 2017.08 (socket outlets: <16A circuits, floor-mounted, near water tap)  |  Q8: 2007.08 (touch voltage calculation — compulsory), 2017.08 (continuity of bonding, ECC resistance, ring circuits) Verification & Testing — inspection, PSCC, insulation Q9 Q9: 2017.08 (PSCC battery circuit, true/false insulation tests) — 2007.Aug Q9 covered non-earthing of conductive parts (see earthing row above) Annex N — IT installations earthing / SANS 10313 — Lightning protection Q10 Q10: 2007.08 (SANS 10313 Lightning protection — compulsory), 2017.08 (Annex N IT installations, functional earthing, CSA) — note: SANS 10313 was P2 Q10 in 2007 but is not part of the current P1 syllabus
Based on past question papers 2004–2026. Q-slot rotation means a topic can move up or down 1–2 questions between sittings. Full syllabus detail is in eBook 00 pages 28–29.

Issue New RTT Key

Generates RTT-{I1}{I2}-{P}{YY}-IR/EC — always exactly 13 characters. P = last digit of phone, YY = issue year (e.g. 726 → phone ends in 7, issued 2026). Duplicate keys for the same email+phone+scope are blocked.

🔑 Group Key — Teaching Cohort

A single GRP-{code} key shared with the whole cohort. Grants full IR + ECSA access. Deactivate when the cohort period ends — existing students keep their access, only new activations are blocked.

    Level 5 · Exam Intelligence
    DHET Exam Predictor & Mock Papers
    📊 How the Prediction Works
    This engine analyses the full LMS question pool (2004–Aug 2026 sitting cycle) using two signals: frequency (how often a topic appears historically) and gap density (how thin coverage is relative to the SANS section depth — indicating overdue topics). Combined score = 50% frequency + 50% gap × section weight. Three strategically different exam papers are generated per sitting.
